## File: facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/thirdparty/github/fairinternal/postman/third_party/grpc/tools/release/release_notes.py

Prompts

```
['run the release notes CLI to generate draft and final Markdown release notes from GitHub PRs', 'get the git merge commit log between two release tags or branches using git log', "get a single PR's metadata from the GitHub API including labels, title, and merged_by info", 'get all PR titles and labels from git merge logs and categorize them by language and release note status', 'write a draft release notes Markdown file listing PRs by missing labels and inclusion status']
```

Usage

```
{'run_release_notes_cli': 'run the release notes CLI to generate draft and final Markdown release notes from GitHub PRs', 'get_commit_log': 'get the git merge commit log between two release tags or branches using git log', 'get_pr_data': "get a single PR's metadata from the GitHub API including labels, title, and merged_by info", 'get_pr_titles': 'get all PR titles and labels from git merge logs and categorize them by language and release note status', 'write_draft': 'write a draft release notes Markdown file listing PRs by missing labels and inclusion status'}
```
